want.description: Under /api/ and at /join: no Browser Integrity Check, no managed rules
Flood cap: 300 requests in 10 s per address, whole site
Public pages and exports, for a request without the session cookie or a Lab token, may be cached as labd says
want.expression: (http.host eq "lab.omarchy-mac.org" and not http.cookie contains "lab_session=" and not any(lower(http.request.headers.names[*])[*] eq "authorization") and not ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/deletion") and (http.request.uri.path in {"/" "/matrix" "/models" "/features" "/gaps" "/aurora" "/benchmarks" "/candidates" "/reports" "/data" "/install" "/install/lab" "/terms" "/privacy" "/api/v1/reports" "/api/v1/reports.json" "/api/v1/reports.csv" "/api/v1/checks" "/api/v1/checks.csv" "/api/v1/matrix" "/api/v1/matrix.json" "/api/v1/benchmarks" "/api/v1/benchmarks.json" "/api/v1/aurora" "/api/v1/aurora.json"} or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/models/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/features/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/candidates/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/reports/")))

want.description: Under /api/: never cached, but an export asked for without the session cookie
want.expression: (http.host eq "lab.omarchy-mac.org" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") and (http.cookie contains "lab_session=" or not http.request.uri.path in {"/api/v1/reports" "/api/v1/reports.json" "/api/v1/reports.csv" "/api/v1/checks" "/api/v1/checks.csv" "/api/v1/matrix" "/api/v1/matrix.json" "/api/v1/benchmarks" "/api/v1/benchmarks.json" "/api/v1/aurora" "/api/v1/aurora.json"}))

owner.name: DNSSEC
owner.how: Cloudflare: DNS > Settings > DNSSEC > Enable, then the DS record it shows goes in at Porkbun

owner.name: the tunnel-health alert
owner.read: [.result[]? | select(.alert_type == "tunnel_health_event" and .enabled == true and ((.mechanisms.email // []) | length) > 0)] | length > 0
owner.how: Cloudflare: Notifications > Add > Tunnel Health Alert, by email

owner.name: the "tunnel created or deleted" alert
owner.read: [.result[]? | select(.alert_type == "tunnel_update_event" and .enabled == true and ((.mechanisms.email // []) | length) > 0)] | length > 0
owner.how: Cloudflare: Notifications > Add > Tunnel Creation or Deletion Event, by email
